battle.name: 天山之戰
battle.brief: 咸亨三年（662年），唐高宗朝在西域天山一線爆發的戰役。昆陵都護阿史那社爾率唐兵與歸義諸部，擊破西突厥阿史那氏殘部與鐵勒部眾的叛軍。卡面秦連弩正可用於此役的守城封隘：連發弩機在山口與壘壁上壓住衝鋒的騎兵，讓唐廷以少量漢兵維持天山北麓的防線。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 天山之戰爆發於唐高宗咸亨三年（662年），是唐王朝在西域天山一線，與西突厥阿史那氏殘部及被裹挾的鐵勒諸部之間的一場戰爭。唐方由中央直轄的北庭、昆陵兩都護府體系出兵：自顯慶二年（657年）蘇定方滅西突厥、車鼻可汗被擒之後，唐在天山南北置昆陵都護府（治庭州）與濛池都護府（治西州），派漢官都護監護屬部，諸部則以阿史那氏宗室任都督、刺史，按部落分屯放牧，交納馬牛絨毯。這套羈縻體制運作數年後，在咸亨初年崩解，鐵勒各部與部分阿史那宗室趁屬官徵斂、畜牧不足而舉兵。叛方並非一個統一政權的軍隊，而是數支部落的聯盟：西突厥故地的大小部眾、契苾與渇官等鐵勒諸部，加上被裹挾的歸義部落合流而成，記錄多以「眾」計，並無固定中軍。交戰地帶在天山北麓的谷地、隘口與草場之間，兩軍都依地形分割部署：唐軍據城守險，叛軍則以騎兵遊走、斷糧、掠營為主。線上雙方的指揮系統一為「皇帝—宰相—都護—都督」的逐級羈縻，與「可汗—葉護—千夫長」的部落式結構並行；這一役的勝負，很大程度上取決於唐廷能否重新把鬆散的部眾編回同一面旗幟之下。
countriesEn: The Battle of the Tianshan broke out in the third year of the Xianheng era of Emperor Gaozong of Tang, 662 CE, between the Tang court and the rump clans of the Western Turks (the Ashina house) together with the Tiele peoples drawn into their rising. On the Tang side the field army came from the two protectorates that governed the Western Regions: after Su Dingfang destroyed the Western Turks in 657 (Xianqing 2) and the Jiebi khan was taken alive, the court set up the Kunling Protectorate, based at Tingzhou, and the Mengchi Protectorate, based at Xizhou, on the two flanks of the Tianshan. Han officials served as protector-general and watched over the dependent tribes, while the tribes themselves were led by Ashina kinsmen appointed as dudu and cishi, each group assigned its own pasture and required to deliver horses, cattle and felt. That system of command and support worked for several years before it came apart in the first years of Xianheng, when the Tiele clans and a number of Ashina kinsmen rose in revolt, prompted by the requisitions of the officials and by a shortage of livestock. The rebel side was never the army of a single state but a coalition of clans: the settled populations of the old Western Turkic territory, Tiele groups such as the Jiebi and the Eguo, and surrendered tribes caught up in the rising, counted in the records only as a 'crowd' and without a permanent central army. The fighting took place among the valleys, the passes and the pastures of the northern Tianshan, and both sides deployed in fragments fitted to that terrain: the Tang held towns and passes, the rebels relied on cavalry that roved, cut supply lines and raided camps. Command ran on the Tang side as a graduated chain of emperor, chancellor, protector-general and dudu, and on the other as the tribal structure of khan, yabghu and thousand-man leaders; the outcome therefore turned largely on whether the court could once more bind scattered clans under one banner.
people: 此役的正史記載極為簡略，幾百字便帶過，因此人物只能從與之相關的官員與將領身上拼湊。唐高宗李治在位，年號咸亨，政務由武則天以「二聖臨朝」的名義主持；西域用兵正是她要解決的難題之一：西邊的鐵勒反覆歸反，已成邊患，年輕的皇帝對這類軍國大事的決斷有限，實際拍板多出自中樞與宰相之議。中樞令李勣是當時最資深的邊將，歷平王世充、滅東突厥、征高句麗，天山用兵的方向理可窺見於其謀劃之中，但前線的主將另有其人。主將一般繫於昆陵都護阿史那社爾。此人是西突厥阿史那氏宗室，顯慶年間隨蘇定方平西突厥後歸唐，授歸義大都督，娶唐宗室女為妻，後拜昆陵都護，坐鎮庭州，是唐廷最能同時通曉兩種語言、也最能壓住部眾的人。與他並肩的是安西都護契苾明，即早年內附唐朝的鐵勒首領契苾何力之子，同樣是唐廷倚重的歸義大員；兩人分道出師，一路由昆陵南下搜討，一線自安西西進，形成南北夾擊之勢。叛方首領在文獻中記作阿史那真、陶的等阿史那氏族人，多是車鼻可汗以降的宗室或部帥，藉「復國」的名號聚眾。基層的關鍵人物則是弩手、譯官、烽燧候吏與牧馬小吏：正是他們決定了山口能否守住、糧草能否接上。
peopleEn: The official record of this campaign is extremely thin — a few hundred characters cover the whole thing — so its personalities have to be assembled from the officials and commanders attached to it. Emperor Gaozong, Li Zhi, reigned under the era name Xianheng, while his empress Wu Zetian, then holding court as the second sovereign, ran the government under the fiction of joint rule. The western campaign was precisely one of the problems she had to solve, because the Tiele on the Tang's western frontier had surrendered and revolted so often that they had become a standing border danger; the young emperor's own resolve in such matters was limited, and the decisions were in practice taken by the secretariat and the chancellors. Li Ji, chancellor and the most seasoned frontier commander of the age — he had served against Wang Shichong, destroyed the Eastern Turks and campaigned against Goguryeo — kept the direction of operations in the Tianshan within his view, though the command in the field belonged to another man. The commander usually identified with the action is Ashina She'er, protector-general of Kunling. An Ashina kinsman of the Western Turks, he came over to the Tang after Su Dingfang's campaign, was granted the rank of gui yi dadu, married a daughter of the imperial house, and was later appointed protector-general at Tingzhou, which made him the man best placed to speak both languages and to hold the clans down. Beside him worked Ashina Ming, protector-general of Anxi and son of Qiebi Heli, the Tiele chieftain who had earlier surrendered to Tang; the two men moved on separate lines, one sweeping south from Kunling, the other pushing west from Anxi, so that the enemy was pinched from two directions. The rebel chiefs appear in the sources under names such as Ashina Zhen and Tao Di, kinsmen and clan commanders of the Jiebi khan's house, who gathered followers under a cry of restoring the old khanate. At the bottom of the story the decisive figures were the crossbowmen, the interpreters, the beacon-watch officers and the herding clerks: they determined whether a pass could be held and whether the grain would arrive.
kits: 天山一役的裝備，核心仍然是弩。卡面這件秦連弩，是弩機把拉力存起來、一踩一發的連發弩具，先秦已在北方邊防用過，到唐代仍作為守具與近距支援武器留在軍中：一名弩手立在城頭、壘壁或山口陣位上踩下扳機，弩機自動擊弦送矢，把沿緩坡衝上的騎兵壓住，不必反覆上弦。描述改良連弩的《魏書》諸葛亮傳一類文獻，把形制記作一槽可納十矢、連機而發；有效射程一般以一百五十至二百步估算，正好對付衝鋒數十步之內的突騎。此役中，連弩主要部署在唐軍的邊鎮城樓、烽燧與壘院，用來封住通往草場的谷口；叛軍同樣自備弓弩，鐵勒騎兵多帶短弓與長矛，靠速度與居高臨下衝撞射手位。除弩之外，唐軍的裝備是典型的高代步軍加歸義騎兵混合：明光鎧與皮甲、長刀與橫刀、方天畫戟與長柄刀、白羽槊與長槊，配以步弓與配弩；攻城破寨則用撞車、雲梯、鉤援與飛石，山地小城則以橫木塞門、積石為壘。交通依賴戰馬與駱駝隊，天山北麓的糧食以青麥、粟與畜肉為主，鹽與茶由河西運入，燃料用木炭與乾糞。歸義部眾還帶著自己的弓箭、革甲與大帳，於是同一支混編隊伍裡存在兩套裝備體系。
kitsEn: The heart of the equipment used in the Tianshan campaign was still the crossbow. The Qin repeating crossbow on the card is a weapon whose trigger mechanism stores the draw and releases a bolt with each stroke of the pedal; it was already in use on the northern frontiers in the pre-Qin period, and by Tang times it remained in the army as a piece for holding ground and for close support. A crossbowman standing on a tower, a rampart or a blocking line in a mountain pass simply steps the lever, the mechanism releases the string of its own accord, and the mass of riders coming up a gentle slope is held down without the shooter ever having to draw the bow again. The texts describing the improved repeating crossbow, the one associated with Zhuge Liang in the Wei histories, give its magazine as holding ten bolts or more, fired in sequence; the effective range is generally reckoned at 150 to 200 paces, which is exactly what matters against cavalry that has closed to within a few dozen paces. In this campaign the repeating crossbows were posted mainly on the towers, beacon stations and stockade courts of the Tang border towns, sealing the valley mouths that led out onto the pastures; the rebels carried bows of their own, and Tiele riders mostly went about with short bows and long spears, relying on speed and on the high ground to overrun the shooting line. Beside the crossbows, the Tang force was a typical mixture of high-generation infantry and surrendered cavalry: brigandines and leather armour, long sabres and straight swords, halberds and long-handled blades, white-feathered spears and long lances, with foot bows and cocked crossbows in support. For storming villages they used battering rams, scaling ladders, grappling hooks and stone-throwers, and where the towns were small and the country steep they simply blocked the gates with timber and piled up stone as a rampart. Movement depended on warhorses and camel trains; on the northern slopes of the Tianshan the food was green wheat, millet and meat, with salt and tea carried in from Hexi, and charcoal and dried dung served as fuel. The surrendered clans brought their own bows, hide armour and great tents, so two systems of equipment coexisted inside the same mixed force.
tactics: 天山北麓的戰術問題，不是正面展開的野戰，而是怎樣在縱長的谷地與無數山口中，把分散的騎兵攔下來。叛軍靠馬力可以在兩三百里的草場上轉移，逼近即擾、退即追，專門破壞道路與屯田；唐軍若一味直追進寬闊的牧地，就會被拖入沒有補給的遊走。唐廷的應對是「守點、斷糧、設伏」：先以昆陵、安西兩都護府所屬的城邑、屯田與烽燧為支點，把山口與水源控在手上；再以輕騎封鎖叛眾在天山南北坡之間往來的通道；最後在叛軍集中攻某一處時，集中弩手與長槊兵一次出擊。具體到陣形上，唐軍在關隘前常以步卒持長槊列在前、弩手居中、騎兵兩翼待機；敵騎衝至百步之內，弩手齊射一輪，長槊壓住人馬，騎兵再從側面插入切斷退路。連弩在這套打法裡的位置最微妙：它不追求遠程單發的精度，而是提供可以在數息之間連續落下的矢幕，專門用來對付速度已經起來的騎隊，迫其減速或改向。攻守之際，破寨用撞車撞門、雲梯靠牆，缺口以長槊封鎖；守方在壘內預備拒馬、滾木與礫石。行軍上，唐軍以三十里一驛的驛傳系統維持公文與輕騎通訊，重隊與糧隊走馳道，趕不上驛程的部分由步軍接力。八月塞外早晚已冷，糧秣消耗大，機會戰往往集中在水源與草場附近。
tacticsEn: The tactical problem on the northern slopes of the Tianshan was not a set-piece battle in the open but how to stop dispersed cavalry in a long series of valleys and endless passes. The rebels' horses could shift across two or three hundred li of pasture, pressing close to harry and then breaking off to pursue, concentrating on wrecking the roads and the farmland. If the Tang chased them straight out into the open grazing land, they would be drawn into a running fight with no resupply. The court's answer was to hold points, cut supplies and spring ambushes: first to take the towns, the farms and the beacon stations of the Kunling and Anxi protectorates as anchors, so that the passes and the water sources were firmly held; then to seal with light horse the corridors by which the rebels moved between the northern and southern slopes; and finally, when the rebels massed against a single point, to bring crossbowmen and lancers out together in one blow. In formation, the Tang commonly posted spearmen with long lances in front, crossbowmen in the middle, and cavalry waiting on the flanks. When the enemy horse closed to within a hundred paces, the crossbowmen loosed a single salvo, the lances pressed the riders down, and the cavalry struck in from the side to cut the retreat. The repeating crossbow held the subtlest place in this scheme: it did not aim for long-range accuracy but supplied a curtain of bolts that could be dropped within a few breaths, aimed precisely at cavalry that had already gathered speed, forcing it to slow or turn aside. In attack, gates were rammed with battering rams, walls were scaled with ladders, and the breaches sealed with long lances; in defence the stockades were lined with chevaux-de-frise, rolling logs and stones. On the march the court kept letters and fast riders moving with a relay system of one post every thirty li, while heavy columns and baggage trains followed the wagon roads, and the remainder of the distance was covered by infantry relay. Out on the steppe in the eighth month the nights were already cold, fodder consumption was heavy, and the fights for position clustered around water and pasture.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，此役的史料本身就是殘篇，這裡只列有根據者與通行估算。第一，時間：咸亨三年（662年），一般繫於該年秋季作戰，戰事多記在八月前後；唐高宗在位年份可由此換算出西元紀年。第二，地形數據：天山山脈東西綿延約二千五百公里，北麓自伊犁、昌吉到阿勒泰一線，漢唐時期的庭州（今新疆吉木薩爾一帶）與北庭都護府即在這條線上；自庭州向西南到碎葉，行程以「里」計，唐制驛傳三十里置一驛，軍隊若不宿營，單程動輒以旬計。第三，武器數據：弩的有效射程通常以一百五十至二百步估算，改良連弩一次儲矢可達十矢以上，連機擊發；弩兵編制以人為單位計算，每人配矢以矢計，補給則按道路里程折算。第四，兵員：正史稱叛眾以「眾」計，數萬乃至二十餘萬；唐方出動的是漢兵與歸義部眾的混編，漢兵比例與各部兵額在傳世文獻中沒有留下明細，因此不宜給出精確人數。第五，後果數字：此役之後唐廷把降眾分置於靈州、朔方與河西一帶屯田，戶籍與馬牛籍帳被重新登記，部眾遷徙時家屬隨行是常態安排。
dataEn: Few figures for this campaign can be verified, since the source material survives only in fragments, so only the supportable ones and the usual estimates are listed here. First, the date: the third year of Xianheng, 662 CE, with the action generally placed in the autumn of that year and the fighting most often recorded around the eighth month; the reign of Gaozong allows the year to be converted to the common era. Second, geography: the Tianshan range runs some 2,500 kilometres from east to west, and along its northern foot lie Ili, Changji and Altay, where the Han and Tang towns of Tingzhou, in the area of present-day Jimsar, and the Beiting Protectorate were situated. From Tingzhou south-westward to Suoye the distance is counted in li, the Tang relay system set a post every thirty li, and an army that did not bivouac covered the ground in tens of days. Third, weapons: the effective range of a crossbow is usually reckoned at 150 to 200 paces, and the improved repeating crossbow held ten or more bolts in its magazine and fired them in sequence; crossbowmen were counted by the man, arrows by the bolt, and supply was reckoned by the mile of road. Fourth, strength: the histories count the rebels as a 'crowd', tens of thousands and in places two hundred thousand; the Tang side was a mixed force of Han soldiers and surrendered clans, and neither the ratio of Han troops to tribal contingents nor the individual tribal quotas survive in the transmitted records, so no exact figure should be given. Fifth, the aftermath in numbers: the defeated clans were broken up and settled in groups, some were moved to Lingzhou, Shuofang and the farms along the Hexi frontier, household registers and tallies of horses and cattle were drawn up anew, and it was normal for the families of the clansmen to follow them into exile.
cause: 起戰的原因是多層的。表層是咸亨初年天山南北的秩序崩解：顯慶二年蘇定方破西突厥之後，唐廷以昆陵、濛池兩都護府羈縻諸部，徵馬、徵兵、徵財的同時又屯田築城，把草原上的部落塞進中原的郡縣框架。鐵勒諸部本就以逐水草而居、畜牧為生，進入天山狹窄的牧地之後遇上寒年，馬匹減少、口糧不足；而都護府屬官的徵斂、差役與兵備徵發，恰恰落在最脆弱的時候。第二層是權力真空。車鼻可汗於顯慶二年被擒送京、西突厥汗號廢除之後，部眾分成無數個千夫長單位，各部首領彼此猜忌；咸亨元年蘇定方病故，唐廷最熟的西域統帥離開，讓許多心懷不滿的部帥看見了機會。第三層是鐵勒與阿史那宗室的聯手：反叛並非單一事件，而是「復可汗之舊」的口號串起來的部族聯盟，各部按出兵多少分配掠獲與牧地。最後是唐廷的判斷：咸亨二年到三年之間，朝廷把這場叛亂定性為邊釁，認為若不立即出兵，昆陵都護府將失去對天山北麓的控制，反軍會與西邊正在強勢的吐蕃接上。因此用兵不是為一場復仇，而是為把西域的防線重新釘回原位。
causeEn: The causes run in several layers. On the surface, the order in the Tianshan collapsed in the first years of Xianheng: after Su Dingfang broke the Western Turks in 657, the court governed the tribes through the two protectorates of Kunling and Mengchi, levying horses, men and money while at the same time opening farms and building towns, and forcing the pastoral clans of the steppe into a command system shaped for the counties of the Chinese interior. The Tiele had always followed the water and the grass and lived on their herds; squeezed into the narrow pastures of the Tianshan and met by a poor year, they lost horses and fell short of grain, and the requisitions, the corvée and the military levies of the protectorate's officials fell exactly on that weakest moment. The second layer was the vacuum of authority. Once the Jiebi khan had been taken alive and sent to the capital in 657 and the khanship itself was abolished, the people split into countless units of a thousand, and the clan chiefs began to distrust one another; when Su Dingfang died of illness in 660, the court lost the one commander who really knew the western roads, and many disappointed clan leaders saw the opening. The third layer was the alliance between the Tiele and the Ashina kinsmen: the revolt was not a single event but a tribal coalition tied together by the cry of restoring the old khanate, with each clan taking a share of the plunder and the pasture according to the men it sent. The last layer was the court's own judgement. Between the second and third years of Xianheng the government classified the rising as a border trouble rather than a local quarrel, on the view that if it did not march at once the protectorate would lose the northern Tianshan and the rebels would join hands with the rising power of Tibet in the west. The war was therefore not a campaign of revenge but an attempt to nail the western frontier line back into place.
impact: 天山之戰的直接結果，是唐在西域的統治暫時回穩，但它的代價與後果，要到往後數十年才完全顯形。短期看，唐廷得以把昆陵都護府對天山北麓的控制重新坐實，叛軍被消滅於山谷與草場之間，部眾被拆散、分部安置，一部分被徙到靈州、朔方與河西的屯田地帶，鐵勒諸部從此再沒有成為獨立的軍事力量；唐朝在西域的實際防線，也從此前的「都護府加屯田」模式，轉為「都護府加羈縻部曲加屯田」的三層結構。更長期的影響有兩條。其一是兵制與裝備：此役證明了連發弩機在守城、封隘、壓制騎兵上的價值，唐軍在北庭與庭州一帶的城樓、烽燧常備弩兵，弩手與長槊兵的混成小隊成為邊軍標準配置之一。其二是外交與地緣：唐廷把西突厥殘部的問題壓下去之後，注意力轉向青海方向，吐蕃在咸亨初年已開始向吐谷渾與西域伸手，一旦天山線上再出現鬆動，唐朝在河西走廊西端的柱石就會被抽走。咸亨三年之後，鐵勒降眾與漢兵的混編屯田雖然穩住了邊地，卻也讓安西四鎮的守軍越來越依賴歸義部眾；一旦朝廷急於抽調屯兵西征，或歸義首領再度生變，這套看似平穩的安排就會立刻露出破綻。
impactEn: The direct result of the Battle of the Tianshan was a temporary restoration of Tang control in the Western Regions, but the cost and the consequences only became fully visible over the following decades. In the short term the court was able to re-establish the authority of the Kunling Protectorate over the northern slopes; the rebels were destroyed among the valleys and pastures, their clans were broken up and settled in groups, part of them was moved to the farms at Lingzhou, Shuofang and in Hexi, and the Tiele never again acted as an independent military force. The practical defence line of the West, which had been a pairing of protectorate and farmland, now became a three-layer structure of protectorate, client clans and farms. Two consequences run further into the future. The first concerns arms and organisation: the campaign demonstrated the value of the repeating trigger mechanism for holding towns, sealing passes and checking cavalry, so that crossbowmen were permanently posted on the towers and beacon stations of Beiting and Tingzhou, and the mixed detachment of crossbowmen and lancers became one of the standard formations of the frontier army. The second is diplomatic and geopolitical: once the problem of the Western Turkic rump had been pushed down, the court's attention turned toward Qinghai, where Tibet had already begun reaching toward the Tiele and the Western Regions in the first years of Xianheng; if the Tian Shan line slackened again, the pillar at the western end of the Hexi Corridor would be pulled away. After 662 the mixed farming garrisons of Tiele settlers and Han soldiers did hold the border together, but they also made the garrisons of the four Anxi fortresses more and more dependent on the client clans; the moment the court hurried to move farm troops west to fight, or the day a client chief rebelled again, that apparently settled arrangement would show its cracks at once.
result: 結局是唐軍的完全勝利，但勝利之後的收編工作，比打仗本身更棘手。傳記記載，叛軍首領阿史那真等人或於戰陣中伏誅，或在追擊中走投無路被部眾所縛；餘眾失去統帥之後，天山南北重新回到唐的旗幟之下。昆陵都護阿史那社爾以歸義首領兼漢官都護的雙重身分，主持了分部的安置：各部按原部落編為新的都督府與刺史單位，指定新的首領，授以印信，配給屯田與牧地，並派兵丁與官吏一同管理；鐵勒降眾有被徙往靈州、朔方者，編入屯田戶籍，與漢兵同列於邊防名籍。從軍事結果看，此役之後的天山北麓再沒有出現能與唐廷對抗的西突厥政權，昆陵都護府對伊犁、昌吉、阿勒泰一線的實際控制延續了下去，直到安史之亂後才真正鬆動。它同時解決了兩個問題：一是把「西突厥」從國家級的威脅降格為零散的羈縻部落，二是讓唐廷相信，只要有一位能統合歸義部眾的將領在位，西域就可以用很少的漢兵維持。代價則是唐廷必須長期負擔西域的駐防、屯田與賞賜成本，而這筆開支最終在中期唐財政吃緊時被壓縮，昆陵、濛池兩都護府也就此漸漸空心化，終為七世紀末的全面退卻埋下伏線。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Tang victory, but the work of taking the defeated in hand after the fighting was thornier than the fighting itself. The records say that the rebel leaders, Ashina Zhen and the rest, were killed on the field or, cornered in the pursuit, bound by their own followers; once the leaders were gone and the multitude — some twenty thousand in one account, several tens of thousands in another — had lost its commander, the northern and southern slopes of the Tianshan came back under Tang banners. Ashina She'er, holding the double status of surrendered chief and Han protector-general, directed the resettlement: each clan was turned into a new dudu or cishi unit, given new leaders, seals of office, farms and pasture, and posted with Tang soldiers and officials to manage it. Some of the Tiele were moved to Lingzhou and Shuofang and enrolled as farming households in the frontier registers alongside Han troops. In military terms, after this campaign no Western Turkic power able to stand against the court reappeared north of the Tianshan, and the actual control of the Kunling Protectorate over the Ili, Changji and Altay line continued for a long time, until it really loosened only after the An Lushan rebellion. It settled two problems at once: it reduced the Western Turks from a threat of state level to scattered client clans, and it persuaded the court that a single commander able to hold the client peoples together could keep the Western Regions with very few Han soldiers. The price was the permanent cost of garrisoning, farming and rewarding the West, and when the Tang finances tightened in the middle ages that spending was squeezed; the Kunling and Mengchi protectorates hollowed out, and that set the stage for the wholesale withdrawal of the late seventh century.
